# Introduction

The **`statsplot2`** analysis (Automatic Plot Selection) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Automatically selects and generates the most appropriate statistical visualization based on variable data types. Features enhanced error messages with contextual guidance, robust data validation, and comprehensive fallback options. Supports both independent and repeated measures designs with various plot types including violin plots, scatter plots, bar charts, and alluvial diagrams.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("statsplot2_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::statsplot2(
#   data = statsplot2_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `statsplot2` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
